general.hint: How Helm starts and opens new tabs.

autostart.label: Start Helm when you sign in to Windows
autostart.hint: Opens Helm in the background when your PC starts.

restoreTabs.label: Reopen tabs on start
restoreTabs.hint: Claude tabs continue the same conversation.

shell.label: Shell
shell.hint: You can also pick a shell per tab from the + menu.

startFolder.label: Starting folder
startFolder.hint: Used when no tab is open. New tabs otherwise open in the current tab's folder.

confirmClose.label: Ask before closing while Claude is working
confirmClose.hint: Applies to closing a tab, a pane or the window.

snipShortcut.label: Shortcut from any app
snipShortcut.hint: Starts a screenshot even when Helm is in the background. Click the box and press the keys you want.

snipAutoCopy.label: Copy each screenshot right away
snipAutoCopy.hint: So you can paste it anywhere straight after taking it. It also opens in Helm's Screenshots tab.

speech.label: Speech to text
speech.hintInstalled: Runs on this PC with NVIDIA Parakeet (English). Nothing you say leaves your PC. Uses {{size}} MB.
speech.hintDownload: Speak instead of typing in Claude tabs. Runs on this PC, nothing is sent anywhere. One-time download of about {{size}} MB, English only.

removeConfirm.message: Delete the voice model? You can download it again any time.
removeConfirm.title: Delete voice model?

mic.label: Microphone
mic.hint: Test it to see the level move while you speak.

holdKey.label: Hold to talk
holdKey.hint: Hold the key while you speak, let go to finish. A quick tap keeps listening until you press it again. Works in Claude tabs.

button.label: Microphone button on Claude tabs
button.hint: A small button in the corner of each Claude tab.

appearance.hint: Make Helm and your terminals look the way you like. Changes show right away.

language.label: Language
language.hint: Helm's menus and screens. Claude answers in whatever language you write to it.

accent.label: Accent color
accent.hint: Used for buttons, highlights, the cursor and selection.

uiScale.label: Interface size
uiScale.hint: Ctrl+mouse wheel outside a terminal also changes this.

mica.label: See-through window (Mica)
mica.hint: Lets your desktop color tint the sidebar and title bar, like Windows 11 apps.

font.label: Font
font.hint: JetBrains Mono and Geist Mono come with Helm. Every language and emoji still renders.

fontSize.label: Text size
fontSize.hint: Ctrl+mouse wheel over a terminal, or Ctrl+= and Ctrl+-.

terminal.hint: How the terminal behaves. Applies to every tab right away.

scrollback.label: Scrollback
scrollback.hint: How many lines each tab keeps so you can scroll back.

copyOnSelect.label: Copy when you select text
copyOnSelect.hint: Selected text goes to the clipboard without pressing Ctrl+C.

pasteWarning.label: Warn before pasting several lines into a shell
pasteWarning.hint: Each line would run as a command. Claude's prompt is never affected.

bell.label: Bell
bell.hint: When a program rings the terminal bell.

gpu.label: Hardware acceleration
gpu.hint: Faster and smoother. Turn off only if text looks wrong on your PC.

notifications.hint: Windows notifications for tabs you're not looking at.

approval.label: When Claude needs approval
approval.hint: With Allow / Deny buttons when approvals are answered in Helm.

usage.label: Usage limit warnings
usage.hint: At 80% and 95% of your 5-hour or weekly limit.

test.title: Helm notifications work
test.body: This is how Helm tells you about tabs you're not looking at.

claudeInHelm.hint: How Helm works with the Claude tabs it starts. Changes apply to new Claude tabs.

approvals.label: Answer approvals in Helm
approvals.hint: When a tab you're not looking at needs permission, ask in Helm and in a Windows notification with Allow / Deny. The tab you're looking at always asks in its terminal.

usageCockpit.label: Track usage limits
usageCockpit.hint: Show your 5-hour and weekly limits, pace and warnings. Uses Claude's status line, so it's skipped if you set up your own status line.

autoOpenAgents.label: Open Background automatically
autoOpenAgents.hint: When Claude starts a subagent or background command, open the side panel on Background (only if it's closed).

usageTips.label: Tips to save usage
usageTips.hint: A heads-up before a conversation's cache goes cold, a one-click /compact when context fills up, attach-as-file for huge pastes, and a nudge for big idle conversations.

openLinksIn.label: Open web links in
openLinksIn.hint: Links in the terminal and in Details, and dev servers you open. Helm's browser can test phone sizes and send errors, screenshots and page elements to Claude.

devServerPrompt.label: Offer to open dev servers
devServerPrompt.hint: When a terminal prints a local address such as localhost:5173, show a button to open it.

windowsHints.label: Windows hints for Claude
windowsHints.hint: Tell Claude it's on Windows and which shell syntax to use, so it stops mixing PowerShell and Bash commands.

shortcuts.hint: Helm uses Ctrl+Shift and Alt+Shift so Claude Code keeps all of its own keys.

import.notHelmFile: This isn't a Helm settings file

resetConfirm.message: Reset every Helm setting to its default? Your tabs, saved prompts and pinned projects stay.
resetConfirm.title: Reset settings?

advanced.hint: For power users. Applies to tabs you open from now on.

extraArgs.label: Extra options when Helm starts Claude
extraArgs.hint: Added after Helm's own options, exactly as typed, e.g. <1>--model sonnet</1> or <1>--add-dir ../shared</1>.

env.label: Environment variables for new tabs
env.hint: One per line: <1>NAME=value</1>. Available to the shell and Claude.

backup.label: Settings backup
backup.hint: Settings, saved prompts and pinned projects in one file.

advanced.dataFolderHint: Settings, hook files and pasted screenshots.

reset.label: Reset settings
reset.hint: Back to defaults. Tabs, prompts and pinned projects are kept.

local.title: Everything stays on this PC
local.text: Your tabs, settings, saved prompts and terminal output never leave your computer. Helm has no account and no analytics or tracking.

network.title: Online only for updates, or when you ask
network.text: On its own, Helm only checks GitHub for a new version, and you can turn that off below. Anything else happens only when you start it: downloading the voice model, requests you send from the API tester, and pages you open in a Helm browser tab.

conversations.title: Claude's conversations
conversations.text: Helm reads the conversation files Claude Code already keeps on your PC to show history, usage and cost. It never uploads them. Claude Code itself talks to Anthropic under Anthropic's own privacy policy.

status.title: Local status connection
status.text: Claude tabs report their status to Helm over a private connection that only works on this PC and needs a secret key that changes every time Helm starts.

privacy.hint: What Helm stores, where, and what you can clear.
privacy.autoUpdateHint: The only connection Helm makes on its own (github.com).

screenshots.hint_one: {{count}} image · {{size}}. Deleted automatically after a week.
screenshots.hint_other: {{count}} images · {{size}}. Deleted automatically after a week.
screenshots.label: Pasted screenshots

closedTabs.hint_one: {{count}} remembered so Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T can reopen them.
closedTabs.hint_other: {{count}} remembered so Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T can reopen them.
closedTabs.label: Recently closed tabs

recentFolder.label: Recent folder
recentFolder.hint: The last folder used, for the “Last used folder” starting option.

privacy.dataFolderHint: Where all of the above lives.
privacy.openSource: Helm is open source, so you can check all of this in the code at github.com/sovanken/helm-term.

about.tagline: A terminal made for Claude Code · free and open source (MIT)
about.autoUpdateHint: Helm looks for a new version when it starts and every few hours.

notices.label: Open-source notices
notices.hint: Helm is built with Tauri, React, xterm.js, Inter, Geist and JetBrains Mono (OFL), and other open-source projects.

about.independent: Helm is an independent community project and is not affiliated with Anthropic.

page.openJsonTitle: Edit Helm's settings as a JSON file (Ctrl+Shift+,)

permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.hint: What Claude may do without asking

hooks.label: Hooks
hooks.hint: Commands that run on Claude events

mode.label: When Claude wants to do something
mode.hint: The starting mode for new conversations. You can still switch with Shift+Tab inside Claude.

permissions.help: Rules look like <1>Tool</1> or <1>Tool(pattern)</1>: <1>Bash(git status)</1>, <1>Bash(npm run test:*)</1>, <1>Edit(src/**)</1>, <1>WebFetch(domain:github.com)</1>, <1>mcp__server__tool</1>. Deny wins over ask, and ask wins over allow.

hooks.commandPlaceholder: Command to run, e.g. npx prettier --write .
hooks.help: The command gets the event's details as JSON on its input. Hooks run with your permissions — only add commands you trust.

mcp.listTitle: All servers Claude can use here
mcp.checking: Checking servers. This can take a few seconds.
mcp.name: Name

memory.notYet: Doesn't exist yet. Saving creates it.
memory.placeholder:
# Project notes for Claude

- How to run and test
- Code style rules
- Things to avoid
memory.hint: Claude reads this at the start of every session.

claudeSettings.intro: {{hint}}. These are the same files Claude Code uses; changes apply to new Claude sessions.
claudeSettings.needsProject: Open a tab in a project first to edit its settings.
claudeSettings.createdOnChange: · created when you make a change

descriptions.language: Interface language. "auto" follows your Windows display language.
descriptions.theme: Color theme: dark, light, or follow Windows (system).
descriptions.accent: Accent color for buttons, highlights and the cursor.
descriptions.uiScale: Interface zoom, from 0.8 to 1.5. 1 is normal size.
descriptions.terminalScheme: Terminal colors. "helm" follows the app theme.
descriptions.fontFamily: Terminal font name, for example "JetBrains Mono" or "Cascadia Mono".
descriptions.sidebarWidth: Width of the sidebar in pixels.
descriptions.changesWidth: Width of the side panel in pixels.
descriptions.restoreTabs: Reopen your tabs (and Claude conversations) when Helm starts.
descriptions.shell: Shell for new tabs: "pwsh", "powershell", "cmd", "bash" (Git Bash) or "wsl".
descriptions.startFolder: Folder for new tabs when none is open: "home", "last", or a full folder path.
descriptions.confirmClose: Ask before closing a tab, pane or the window while Claude is working.
descriptions.openLinksIn: Where links and dev servers open: a Helm browser tab ("helm") or your own browser ("browser").
descriptions.devServerPrompt: Offer to open a dev server when a terminal prints its address.
descriptions.deviceFrame: Draw a phone, tablet or laptop outline around pages shown at a device size.
descriptions.projectSort: Order of projects in the sidebar.
descriptions.privacyBlur: Blur project names and conversation titles in the sidebar (for screen sharing).
descriptions.snipShortcut: Key combination that starts a screenshot from any app, for example "Ctrl+Alt+S". Empty turns it off.
descriptions.snipAutoCopy: Copy each new screenshot to the clipboard straight away.
descriptions.voiceMic: Microphone for voice input, by its name in Windows. Empty uses the Windows default.
descriptions.voiceHoldKey: Key to hold while speaking. Empty turns it off.
descriptions.voiceButton: Show the mic button on Claude tabs.
descriptions.scrollback: Lines each terminal keeps to scroll back through.
descriptions.copyOnSelect: Copy text as soon as you select it in a terminal.
descriptions.rightClick: Right-click in a terminal: copy the selection or paste ("smart"), or always paste ("paste").
descriptions.bell: What happens when a terminal rings its bell.
descriptions.pasteWarning: Ask before pasting many lines into a terminal.
descriptions.gpu: Draw terminals with hardware acceleration (faster). Turn off if text looks wrong.
descriptions.approvals: Answer Claude's approval requests from background tabs inside Helm.
descriptions.usageCockpit: Show your Claude usage limits in the status bar.
descriptions.windowsHints: Tell Claude it runs on Windows and which shell syntax to use.
descriptions.autoOpenAgents: Open the side panel on Background when Claude starts a subagent or background command.
descriptions.usageTips: Show tips that save usage (cache about to expire, compact a long conversation, and so on).
descriptions.hiddenStatusItems: Status bar items you switched off (right-click the status bar).
descriptions.notifications: Windows notifications for tabs you're not looking at.
descriptions.notifyApproval: Notify when Claude needs your approval.
descriptions.notifyUsage: Notify when you near a usage limit.
descriptions.extraClaudeArgs: Extra arguments for every new Claude tab, for example "--model opus".
descriptions.extraEnv: Extra environment variables for new tabs, one KEY=value per line (use \n between lines).

toasts.broken: settings.json has a mistake, so nothing changed. The editor marks where.
toasts.partial_one: Settings saved, except one line Helm couldn't use (marked in the editor).
toasts.partial_other: Settings saved, except {{count}} lines Helm couldn't use (marked in the editor).
toasts.changedOutside: settings.json was changed outside Helm and has a mistake, so Helm kept your current settings.
